title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
summary: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.
reason: Reports a non-model product launch: Google released a developer tool letting PyTorch users move apps off Nvidia GPUs. This is an industry/competitive event covered by a reputable media report (techcrunch.com) with a publication date, not an official model or OSS repo announcement.
